pairs: Et factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam secundo,
And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah a second time,
cum adhuc clausus esset in atrio carceris,
while he was still confined to the atrium of the prison,
Cry out to me and I will heed you.
And I will announce to you great things,
though you do not know them.
Quia hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël ad domos urbis hujus,
For thus says the Lord, the God of Israel, to the houses of this city,
and to the houses of the king of Judah,
et impleant eas cadaveribus hominum quos percussi in furore meo
so that they may fight with the Chaldeans,
and so that they may have their fill of the dead bodies of the men whom I have struck down in my fury and in my indignation,
abscondens faciem meam a civitate hac,
concealing my face from this city,
Ecce ego obducam eis cicatricem et sanitatem,
Behold, I will lead over them scars and health,
et revelabo illis deprecationem pacis et veritatis.
And I will reveal to them an invocation of peace and truth.
And I will convert the turning away of Judah and the turning away of Jerusalem.
And I will build them up,
et ædificabo eos sicut a principio.
Et emundabo illos ab omni iniquitate sua in qua peccaverunt mihi,
And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity,
et propitius ero cunctis iniquitatibus eorum,
by which they have sinned against me.
And I will forgive all their iniquities,
by which they have offended against me and have despised me.
And this will be for me: a name,
and a joy, and a praise,
et in exsultationem cunctis gentibus terræ, quæ audierint omnia bona quæ ego facturus sum eis:
among all the nations of the earth who will hear about all the good things that I will accomplish for them.
et pavebunt et turbabuntur in universis bonis,
And they will be afraid and troubled over all these good things,
et in omni pace quam ego faciam eis.
and over all the peace, that I will accomplish for them.
Adhuc audietur in loco isto quem vos dicitis esse desertum,
Still shall there be heard in this place,
eo quod non sit homo nec jumentum in civitatibus Juda,
because there is neither man nor beast,)
and in the cities of Judah and outside of Jerusalem,
and without an inhabitant and without cattle,)
the voice of gladness and the voice of rejoicing,
vox sponsi et vox sponsæ, vox dicentium:
the voice of the groom and the voice of the bride,
the voice of those who will say:
For the Lord is good! For his mercy is eternal!’
et portantium vota in domum Domini:
and the voice of those fulfilling their vows in the house of the Lord.
reducam enim conversionem terræ sicut a principio,
For I will lead back the turning away of the land, just as from the beginning,
Thus says the Lord of hosts:
Adhuc erit in loco isto deserto,
“Still shall there be in this place,
(which is desolate without man and without beast,)
and in all of its cities:
a habitation for the shepherds giving rest to their flocks.
For even in the cities on the mountains,
and in the cities on the plains,
et in civitatibus quæ ad austrum sunt,
and in the cities that are toward the south,
and in the land of Benjamin,
and in the cities of Judah,
adhuc transibunt greges ad manum numerantis,
still shall the flocks travel by the hand of him who numbers them,
et suscitabo verbum bonum quod locutus sum ad domum Israël
when I will fulfill the good word that I have spoken to the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.
In diebus illis et in tempore illo germinare faciam David germen justitiæ,
In those days and at that time, I will cause the seedling of justice to spring up from David,
et faciet judicium et justitiam in terra:
and he will accomplish judgment and justice upon the earth.
In those days, Judah will be saved,
and Jerusalem will live in confidence.
et hoc est nomen quod vocabunt eum:
And this is the name that they will call him:
Non interibit de David vir qui sedeat super thronum domus Israël:
There shall not cease to be a man from David sitting upon the throne of the house of Israel.
And there shall not cease to be a man from the priests and from the Levites before my face,
et de Levitis non interibit vir a facie mea,
Et factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam,
And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah,
Si irritum potest fieri pactum meum cum die,
If my covenant with the day is able to be nullified,
or my covenant with the night,
ut non sit dies et nox in tempore suo,
such that there would be no day and no night in their time,
et pactum meum irritum esse poterit cum David servo meo, ut non sit ex eo filius qui regnet in throno ejus, et Levitæ et sacerdotes ministri mei.
then, too, my covenant with David, my servant, may be nullified, such that he would not have a son who reigns upon his throne, with both the Levites and the priests as my ministers.
Sicuti enumerari non possunt stellæ cæli,
Just as the stars of heaven are not able to be numbered,
et metiri arena maris, sic multiplicabo semen David servi mei,
and the sand of the sea is not able to be measured, so will I multiply the offspring of David,
my servant, and the Levites, my ministers.”
Et factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam,
And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah,
Numquid non vidisti quid populus hic locutus sit,
“Have you not seen what this people has spoken?
Duæ cognationes quas elegerat Dominus abjectæ sunt?
‘The two families which the Lord had chosen have been rejected.’
And so they have despised my people,
eo quod non sit ultra gens coram eis.
as if they were no longer a nation in their sight.
Si pactum meum inter diem et noctem,
If I have not established my covenant with the day and the night,
et leges cælo et terræ non posui,
and my laws over heaven and earth,
then truly I will also cast aside the offspring of Jacob,
ut non assumam de semine ejus principes seminis Abraham,
so that I do not take up any of his offspring to be leaders over the offspring of Abraham,
For I will lead back their turning away,
and I will take pity on them.”
